import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import fsolve

N = 150000
logN = np.log(N)
TARGET = 10.0

# Three groups: n1 high-prob, n2 mid-prob, n3 low-prob (tiny) -> 2 continuous dof
n1 = 7
n2 = 100
n3 = N - n1 - n2

def probs(x):
    p1, p2 = np.exp(x)
    p3 = (1.0 - n1*p1 - n2*p2)/n3
    return p1, p2, p3

def metrics(p1,p2,p3):
    logs = np.array([np.log(p1), np.log(p2), np.log(p3)])
    ns = np.array([n1,n2,n3])
    ps = np.array([p1,p2,p3])
    H = -np.sum(ns*ps*logs)
    fKL = logN - H
    bKL = -logN - np.sum(ns*logs)/N
    return fKL, bKL

def eqs(x):
    p1,p2,p3 = probs(x)
    fKL,bKL = metrics(p1,p2,p3)
    return [fKL-TARGET, bKL-TARGET]

# initial guess: high tokens carry ~all mass, entropy ~1.9 nats
# p1 ~ 1/7*... , p3 ~ e^-22
x0 = [np.log(0.14), np.log(1e-4)]
sol = fsolve(eqs, x0, full_output=True)
x = sol[0]
p1,p2,p3 = probs(x)
fKL,bKL = metrics(p1,p2,p3)
print("p1,p2,p3=",p1,p2,p3,"p3>0:",p3>0)
print("fKL,bKL=",fKL,bKL)

dist = np.empty(N)
dist[:n1]=p1
dist[n1:n1+n2]=p2
dist[n1+n2:]=p3
print("sum=",dist.sum(),"min=",dist.min())
# recompute exact from array
def arr_metrics(d):
    fKL = np.sum(d*np.log(d)) + logN
    bKL = -logN - np.mean(np.log(d))
    return fKL,bKL
print("array metrics:",arr_metrics(dist))
np.save("/app/dist.npy", dist)

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq

N = 150000
logN = np.log(N)
TARGET = 10.0
n1 = 7
n2 = 100
n3 = N - n1 - n2

def metrics(p1,p2,p3):
    ns=np.array([n1,n2,n3]); ps=np.array([p1,p2,p3]); logs=np.log(ps)
    H=-np.sum(ns*ps*logs)
    return logN-H, -logN-np.sum(ns*logs)/N

# For given p1, choose p3 to hit backward KL exactly (brentq), p2 from normalization
def solve_p3(p1):
    def bk(logp3):
        p3=np.exp(logp3)
        p2=(1.0-n1*p1-n3*p3)/n2
        if p2<=0: return 1e6
        return metrics(p1,p2,p3)[1]-TARGET
    lp3=brentq(bk, np.log(1e-15), np.log(1e-6))
    p3=np.exp(lp3); p2=(1.0-n1*p1-n3*p3)/n2
    return p2,p3

def fk_resid(p1):
    p2,p3=solve_p3(p1)
    return metrics(p1,p2,p3)[0]-TARGET

# fKL increases as p1 increases (more concentration). find root
p1=brentq(fk_resid, 0.05, 0.142)
p2,p3=solve_p3(p1)
print("p:",p1,p2,p3)
print("metrics:",metrics(p1,p2,p3))

dist=np.empty(N)
dist[:n1]=p1; dist[n1:n1+n2]=p2; dist[n1+n2:]=p3
fKL=np.sum(dist*np.log(dist))+logN
bKL=-logN-np.mean(np.log(dist))
print("array:",fKL,bKL,"sum:",dist.sum(),"min:",dist.min())
assert abs(fKL-10)<=1e-3 and abs(bKL-10)<=1e-3 and dist.min()>0 and abs(dist.sum()-1)<1e-9
np.save("/app/dist.npy",dist)
print("SAVED ok")
